Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim cJournals Dim bContinue Dim bPostToAvalara Dim nLastAvalaraTransaction If Forms.DoRoleCheck("ARPost") = True Then Dim cInvoice cInvoice = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value) bContinue = True
' Do an initial check to see if the ar invoice is posted, if so, don't continue and don't show a message as this will have been handled in the saving code (if the record is not saved). If CBool(App.Ax("AR").ARInvoicePostedCheck(arg.BindingSource.Transaction, cInvoice)) = True Then Exit Function End If
' Avalara Check and post If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated And arg.BindingSource.Fields("arpAvalaraOverrideTax").Value = False Then bContinue = True bPostToAvalara = True
nLastAvalaraTransaction = App.Ax("AvalaraTax").CheckLastSuccessfulTransaction(arg.BindingSource) If (nLastAvalaraTransaction <> 3 And nLastAvalaraTransaction <> 4) Or arg.BindingSource.Fields("arpAvalaraTaxCalculated").Value = 0 Then ' Not 3(GetTax) or 4(PostTax) therefore tax not yet calcualted, or somethings has been changed and tax not yet calculated after that bPostToAvalara = False ' Check Avalara setting to see if this hsould be ignore, warn with message, or disallowed Select Case CInt(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafAvalaraARInvoicePostOption").Value) Case 1: 'Ignore ' Set Override flag Connection.Execute "UPDATE ARInvoices SET arpAvalaraOverrideTax = 1 WHERE arpARInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSQL(cInvoice) bContinue = True Case 2: 'Warn - Default If Forms.MessageBox("Avalara Tax has not been calculated for invoice " & cInvoice & ". Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbNo Then bContinue = False Else Connection.Execute "UPDATE ARInvoices SET arpAvalaraOverrideTax = 1 WHERE arpARInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSQL(cInvoice) bContinue = True End If Case 3: 'Disable Call Forms.MessageBox("Invoice cannot be posted. Please calculate Sales tax via Avalara before proceeding.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Error") bContinue = False Case Else: 'Safety Net?
End Select End If If nLastAvalaraTransaction = 4 Then ' Already posted bPostToAvalara = False End If If bContinue = True And bPostToAvalara = True then Dim cMsg cMsg = App.Ax("AvalaraTax").PostTax(arg.BindingSource) If Trim(cMsg) = "" Or Left(Trim(cMsg), 7) = "Warning" Then bContinue = true Else Call Forms.MessageBox("Avalara Post Tax cannot be completed: " & Chr(13) & Trim (cMsg), vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Error") bContinue = False End If End If Else bContinue = True End If
If bContinue = True Then If Forms.MessageBox("This will post invoice " & cInvoice & " to the General Ledger. Once an invoice has been posted, it cannot be modified. Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then cShipmentIDs = App.Ax("AR").PostInvoiceCheck(cInvoice) If cShipmentIDs = "" Then cJournals = Trim(App.Ax("AR").PostInvoice(arg.BindingSource)) If Trim(cJournals) <> "" Then If App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARExpressPost").Value = True Then Call App.Ax("GLFunctions").PostSelectedJournals(cJournals, "", False, True) End If If CBool(arg.BindingSource.Fields("arpIntraCompany").Value) = True And CBool(App.Security.IsInRole("IntraCompanyPost")) = True Then 'Call Forms.RunTransferProcess("M1.Ax.Erp.TransferARInvoiceToAPInvoiceProcess", Null, Array(cInvoice)) End If End If Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("SalesOrders") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("SalesOrderLines") Else Call Forms.MessageBox("The AR invoice cannot be posted until the following shipments have been posted:" & vbcrlf & cShipmentIDs, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") End If End If End If Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim cExtra Dim rsPaymentHeader Dim nSession Dim info Dim bContinue Dim bPostToAvalara Dim cMsg
If Forms.DoRoleCheck("ARPaymentPost") = True Then nSession = arg.BindingSource.Fields("arsARPaymentSessionID").Value Set info = App.Ax("AR").GetARPaymentInfo(nSession) If CDbl(arg.BindingSource.Fields("arsDepositAmount").Value) - CDbl(info.AmountClearedBase) - CDbl(info.ExchangeAmount) <> 0 Then cExtra = Chr(13) & "***WARNING***" & Chr(13) & "The amount remaining to be cleared is not zero." End If Set rsPaymentHeader = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPaymentHeader.Open "Select Count(*) AS HeaderCount From ARPaymentHeaders Where artARPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nSession), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsPaymentHeader.Fields("HeaderCount").Value > 0 Then
If App.Ax("Production").AvalaraActivated = True Then ' Avalara is setup bContinue = True bPostToAvalara = True If arg.BindingSource.Fields("arsAvalaraTaxCalculated").Value = 0 Then bPostToAvalara = False If Forms.MessageBox("Avalara Tax has not been calculated for payment session " & Trim(CStr(nSession)) & ". Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbNo Then bContinue = False End If End If If bContinue = True And bPostToAvalara = True Then cMsg = App.Ax("AvalaraTax").PostPaymentTax(arg.BindingSource) If Trim(cMsg) = "" Or Left(Trim(cMsg),7) = "Warning" Then bContinue = True Else Call Forms.MessageBox("Avalara Post Payment Tax cannot be completed: " & Chr(13) & Trim(cMsg), vbExclamation + vbokonly, "Error") bContinue = False End If End If Else bContinue = True End If
If bContinue = True Then If Forms.MessageBox("This will post payment session " & Trim(CStr(nSession)) & " to the General Ledger. Once a payment session has been posted, it cannot be modified. Do you want to continue?" & cExtra, vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then If App.Ax("ARFunctions").PostPaymentSession(nSession) = True Then Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call App.Ax("Production").RefreshTable("ARInvoices") End If End If End If Else Call Forms.MessageBox("There are no Payment Headers to be posted for AR Payment Session " & Trim(CStr(nSession)), vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "Confirm") End If rsPaymentHeader.Close End If End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) ' Check if current schedule for fiscal year/period exist and posted, if so, exit out Dim nYear Dim nPeriod Dim rsLookup
nYear = arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value nPeriod = arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select fasAssetID From AssetSchedules Where fasAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringtoSQL(Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaAssetID").Value)) + " And fasType = 'BOOK' And fasGLFiscalYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nYear) + " And fasGlFiscalYearPeriodID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nPeriod) + " And fasPostedToGL = 1", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then ' record exist for fiscal year/period, BOOK, posted Call Forms.MessageBox("Asset schedule already exist for asset " & Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaAssetID").Value) & " fiscal year/period " & nYear & "/" & nPeriod & " and has already been posted.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "Error") Exit function End If rsLookup.Close
' For Transfer to pool type, check if pool year has already been created, if not, do not allow post If arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value = "P" Then rsLookup.Open "Select *From AssetLowValuePool Where favPoolYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value) + " And favClosed = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then ' No record in pool for adjustment year Call Forms.MessageBox("Pool Year " & arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value & " has not been created in Asset Low Value Pool table or is closed. Please create or re-open Pool year entry before posting transfer.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMVALIDATIONMESSAGE", "Confirm Validation Message")) Exit function End If rsLookup.Close End If
Dim nID nID = arg.BindingSource.Fields("faaAssetAdjustmentID").Value If Forms.MessageBox("This will post asset adjustment " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nID)) + " to the General Ledger. Once an adjustment has been posted, it cannot be modified. Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then If App.Ax("GLFunctions").PostAssetAdjustment(nID) = True Then Call Forms.MessageWindow("Adjustment " & Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nID)) & " has been posted", 5) Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(1) End If End If End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim nYear, cPlant Dim nTotalID Dim rsTotals, rsEmployees Dim nYearStartDate, nYearEndDate, cSQL

Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then Set rsTotals = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTotals.Open "Select * From Form1094YearTotals Where 0=1", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText Connection.Execute "Delete From Form1094YearTotals Where hctForm1094YearID =" & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nYear) & " And hctPlantID = " & App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPlant) nTotalID = 0
Set rsEmployees = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") nYearStartDate = Dateserial(nYear, 1, 1) nYearEndDate = Dateserial(nYear, 12, 31) cSQL = "Select lmeEmployeeID, lmdEmployeeFirstName, lmdEmployeeMiddleName, lmdEmployeeLastName, lmdTaxFileNumber, lmdAddressLine1, lmdAddressLine2, lmdCity, lmdState, lmdPostCode " & _ " From Employees Inner Join EmployeePersonalData On lmeEmployeeID = lmdEmployeeID " & _ " Where lmePayrollEmployee <> 0 and (((lmeTerminationDate is null) or (lmeTerminationDate >= " + App.Convert.DateToSQL(nYearStartDate) + ")) and lmeHireDate <= " + App.Convert.DateToSQL(nYearEndDate) + ")" rsEmployees.Open cSQL, Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText Do While rsEmployees.EOF = False rsTotals.AddNew rsTotals.Fields("hctForm1094YearID").Value = nYear rsTotals.Fields("hctPlantID").Value = cPlant nTotalID = nTotalID + 1 rsTotals.Fields("hctForm1094YearTotalID").Value = nTotalID rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeID").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeFirstName").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdEmployeeFirstName").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeMiddleName").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdEmployeeMiddleName").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeLastName").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdEmployeeLastName").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeSSN").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdTaxFileNumber").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeAddressLine1").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdAddressLine1").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeAddressLine2").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdAddressLine2").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeCity").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdCity").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeeState").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdState").Value) rsTotals.Fields("hctEmployeePostCode").Value = Trim(rsEmployees.Fields("lmdPostCode").Value) rsEmployees.MoveNext Loop rsEmployees.Close
If rsTotals.RecordCount > 0 Then rsTotals.UpdateBatch End If rsTotals.Close
If arg.BindingSource.Fields("hcpTotal1095Attached").Value <> nTotalID Then arg.BindingSource.Fields("hcpTotal1095Attached").Value = nTotalID arg.BindingSource.Fields("hcpTotal1095Count").Value = nTotalID End If
Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3)
End If
End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim nCountID, allowNegativeQtyOnHand, enableWarningWhenNegative, cMessage nCountID = arg.BindingSource.Fields("imnInventoryCountID").Value allowNegativeQtyOnHand = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand")) enableWarningWhenNegative = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative"))
Dim rsLookup, cExtra Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select IsNull(Count(*),0) as tracked_count from InventoryCountLines Inner Join Parts on imqPartID = impPartID where imqInventoryCountID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nCountID) + _ " And imqCountedDate Is Not Null And (impTrackLotNumbers = 1 Or impTrackSerialNumbers = 1)", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsLookup.Fields("tracked_count").value) > 0 Then cExtra = "Count " & nCountID & " has lot or serial tracked parts with a counted date. All lot or serial numbers not moved to the selected side will have their quantities set to zero." + Chr(13) + Chr(13) End If End If Set rsLookup = Nothing
If allowNegativeQtyOnHand Then cExtra = "" End If
If Forms.MessageBox(cExtra + "This will post count " & nCountID & " to inventory. Once the inventory count has been posted, it cannot be modified. Do you want to continue?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then If CBool(App.Ax("InventoryCount").InventoryCountPeriodCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = False Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be posted, as the fiscal period for one or more counted dates has been closed or does not exist. Either the counted date(s) will need to be changed or the fiscal period will need to be opened/created.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If End If
If allowNegativeQtyOnHand Then cMessage = App.Ax("InventoryCount").PostInventoryCountInactiveBinsCheck(arg.BindingSource) If cMessage <>"" Then Forms.MessageBox "This Inventory Count CAN NOT be posted because there are INACTIVE bins where the Final Count is negative for the Inventory Count Lines indicated." + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + cMessage, vbOkOnly + vbExclamation, "Confirm" Exit Function End If cMessage = App.Ax("InventoryCount").PostInventoryCountCheck(arg.BindingSource) If enableWarningWhenNegative and cMessage <>"" Then If Forms.MessageBox("This transaction WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand. Are you sure?" + vbCrLf + cMessage, vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Bin Transfer") = vbNo Then Exit Function End If End If End If
Call App.Ax("InventoryCount").PostInventoryCount(arg.BindingSource) Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Connection.Execute "delete inventorysynctable where imyinventorycountid = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(nCountID) End If End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim bProcess Dim cSQL, cErrorChargeList, cMessage Dim rsPOInTransitJnl, rsCharges Dim nCount
bProcess = false cErrorChargeList = "" cMessage = ""
Set rsPOInTransitJnl = createobject("ADODB.RECORDSET") Set rsCharges = createobject("ADODB.RECORDSET")
If MsgBox("This will complete the charges info section for landed cost " + arg.BindingSource.Fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value + ". Once this has occured, it cannot be undone. End if Else cMessage = "There are no landed cost charges entered." End If rsCharges.close
If trim(cMessage) <> "" then Call MsgBox(Trim(cMessage), vbOkOnly + vbExclamation, "Confirm") bProcess = false Else cSQL = "Select rmcLandedcostID from LandedCosts where rmcLandedcostID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(arg.BindingSource.Fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value) + " and rmcPOInTransitComplete <> 0" rsPOInTransitJnl.open cSQL, Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText if rsPOInTransitJnl.EOF then Call MsgBox("Purchase order in-transit journals have not been created.", vbOkOnly + vbExclamation, "Confirm") bProcess = false else bProcess = true End If rsPOInTransitJnl.close End If End If

Function ProcessCommand(arg) ' Do an initial check to see if the material issue is posted, if so, don't continue and don't show a message as this will have been handled in the saving code (if the record is not saved). If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(arg.BindingSource.Transaction, arg.BindingSource.Fields("iniMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Exit Function End If
If MsgBox("Once this record is posted, you will be unable to modify it and quantities will be updated on the job / in inventory. Do you wish to continue?",vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Exit function Else If CBool(Forms.DoRoleCheck("MATISSUEPOST")) = True Then If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePeriodCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = False Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be posted, as the fiscal period for this transaction date has been closed or does not exist. Either the transaction date will need to be changed or the fiscal period will need to be opened/created.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If End If Dim returnMsg,inactiveMsg ' Check to see if any future adjustments (inventory count / qty adjust) and warn user returnMsg = Trim(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").CheckMaterialIssueForFutureAdjustmentTransactions(arg.Bindingsource)) If Trim(returnMsg)<>"" Then If MsgBox(returnMsg, vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Exit function End If End If inactiveMsg = App.Ax("MaterialIssue").VerifyInactiveBinsMiscOrJobIssue(arg.Bindingsource) if inactiveMsg<>"" Then call msgbox("This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin for the part(s) indicated."& vbCrLf & vbCrLf & inactiveMsg,vbExclamation+vbOkOnly,"Confirm") exit function end if inactiveMsg = App.Ax("MaterialIssue").VerifyInactiveBinsForReturnToJob(arg.Bindingsource) if inactiveMsg<>"" Then call msgbox("This transaction CAN NOT be posted because an INACTIVE bin exists for the part(s) indicated."& vbCrLf & vbCrLf & inactiveMsg,vbExclamation+vbOkOnly,"Confirm") exit function end if returnMsg = App.Ax("MaterialIssue").PostMaterialIssueCheck(arg.Bindingsource) FoundIt = InStr(1, returnMsg, ";;") If Trim(returnMsg) = "" OR FoundIt Then Dim negativeStockWarningMessage negativeStockWarningMessage = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative") If negativeStockWarningMessage Then Dim length length=Len(returnMsg) If FoundIt Then If MsgBox("This transaction WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for the part(s) indicated. Are you sure?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & MID(returnMsg,1,length-2) ,vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbYes Then SaveBindingSource(arg) End If Else SaveBindingSource(arg) End If Else SaveBindingSource(arg) End If Else Call MsgBox(returnMsg, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If End If End If End Function
Private Function SaveBindingSource(arg) Call App.Ax("MaterialIssue").PostMaterialIssue(arg.Bindingsource) Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobMaterials") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobOperations") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobAssemblies") Call RefreshPartAllocations(arg) End Function
Private Function RefreshPartAllocations(arg) Dim isKitPart Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT injPartID, injPartRevisionID, injKitPart FROM MaterialIssueLines WHERE injMaterialIssueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(arg.BindingSource.Fields("iniMaterialIssueID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Do While oRs.EOF = false isKitPart = cbool(oRs.Fields("injKitPart").value) If isKitPart Then Call RefreshKitPartAllocations(arg, oRs.Fields("injPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value) End If Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(arg.BindingSource.Transaction, oRs.Fields("injPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value) oRs.MoveNext() loop end if oRs.Close Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartBins") End Function
Private Function RefreshKitPartAllocations(arg, methodID, methodRevisionID) Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT immPartID, immPartRevisionID FROM PartMaterials WHERE immMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(methodID) + " AND immMethodRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(methodRevisionID),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Do While oRs.EOF = false Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(arg.BindingSource.Transaction, oRs.Fields("immPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("immPartRevisionID").Value) oRs.MoveNext() loop End If oRs.Close End Function

cWhere = "" If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MP") = True Then cWhere = " And pasPlantID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPlant) End If Set rsSessions = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSessions.Open "Select pasPayrollSessionID From PayrollSessions Where pasTaxYear = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nYear) & cWhere & " And pasPayrollStartDate >= " & App.Convert.DateToSQL(dStartDate) & " And pasPayrollEndDate <= " & App.Convert.DateToSQL(dEndDate) & " And pasPostedToGL = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSessions.EOF = False Then ' There are unposted payroll session in the current tax year for the current plant Call Forms.MessageBox("There are unposted payroll sessions related to the current date range. Please post or delete all unposted payroll session within the date range before proceeding.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly) Exit Function End If rsSessions.Close

Do you want to continue?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Update")) = vbYes Then ' Get Totals Set rsTotals = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTotals.Open "select ISNULL(SUM(Case When (pafTaxCategory = 'T' Or pafTaxCategory = 'C') And pafPaidBy = 2 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalPAYE, " & _ "ISNULL(SUM(Case When panPayrollLineType = 'D' And ISNULL(paeChildSupport,IsNull(padChildSupport,0)) <> 0 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalChildSupport, " & _ "ISNULL(SUM(Case When panPayrollLineType = 'D' And ISNULL(paeStudentLoan,IsNull(padStudentLoan,0)) <> 0 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalStudentLoan, " & _ "ISNULL(SUM(Case When panPayrollLineType = 'D' And ISNULL(paeSuperannuation,IsNull(padSuperannuation,0)) <> 0 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalEmployeeKiwiSaver, " & _ "ISNULL(SUM(Case When panPayrollLineType = 'L' And ISNULL(paoSuperannuation,0) <> 0 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalEmployerKiwiSaver, " & _ "ISNULL(SUM(Case When pafTaxCategory = 'Z' And pafPaidBy = 1 Then panAmount Else 0 End), 0) As TotalESCT " & _ "From PayrollSessions inner join PayrollHeaders on PasPayrollSessionID = patPayrollSessionID " & _ "inner join PayrollLines on patPayrollSessionID = panPayrollSessionID And patPayrollHeaderID = panPayrollHeaderID " & _ "left outer join IncomeTaxes on panIncomeTaxID = paxIncomeTaxID " & _ "left outer join IncomeTaxTypes on panIncomeTaxID = pafIncomeTaxID And panIncomeTaxTypeID = pafIncomeTaxTypeID " & _ "left outer join Deductions on panDeductionID = padDeductionID " & _ "left outer join EmployeeDeductions on panEmployeeID = paeEmployeeID And panDeductionID = paeDeductionID And panEmployeeDeductionID = paeEmployeeDeductionID " & _ "left outer join Allowances on panAllowanceID = paoAllowanceID " & _ "Where pasTaxYear = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nYear) & cWhere & " And pasPayrollDate >= " & App.Convert.DateToSQL(dStartDate) & " And pasPayrollDate <= " & App.Convert.DateToSQL(dEndDate), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTotals.EOF = False Then arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalPAYE").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalPAYE").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalChildSupport").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalChildSupport").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalStudentLoan").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalStudentLoan").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalKiwiSaver").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalEmployeeKiwiSaver").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalKiwiSaverEmployer").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalEmployerKiwiSaver").Value - rsTotals.Fields("TotalESCT").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalESCT").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalESCT").Value arg.BindingSource.Fields("nzdTotalAmountsPayable").Value = rsTotals.Fields("TotalPAYE").Value + rsTotals.Fields("TotalChildSupport").Value + rsTotals.Fields("TotalStudentLoan").Value + rsTotals.Fields("TotalEmployeeKiwiSaver").Value + rsTotals.Fields("TotalEmployerKiwiSaver").Value End If rsTotals.Close End If End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) If Not App.Security.IsInRole("ADJUSTQTY") Or Not App.Security.IsInRoleByTable("PartTransactions", "Add") Or Not App.Security.IsInRoleByTable("PartBins", "Edit") Then Exit Function End If
Dim cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, dDateCounted, cMessage cPartID = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqPartID").Value) cRevisionID = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqPartRevisionID").Value) cWareHouse = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqPartBinID").Value) dDateCounted = arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqAdjustmentDate").Value
If CInt(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select imtPartTransactionID From PartTransactions Where imtPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " and imtPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " and imtPartWarehouseLocationID = " + + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWarehouse) + " and imtPartBinID = " + + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBin) + " and imtTransactionType = 3 " & _ " and imtTransactionDate >= " & App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(dDateCounted) & " and imtTransactionDate <= " & App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(Date), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Call Forms.MessageBox("There are adjustment entries existing for the current part between the Date Counted and the Current Date." & Chr(13) & "Please rectify and enter adjustment as of current date.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMVALIDATIONMESSAGE", "Confirm Validation Message")) Exit Function End If End If
Dim lotTrackedMsg If CBool(App.Ax("LotNumbers").IsLotTracked(cPartID)) = True Then lotTrackedMsg = "As the part selected is a lot tracked part, all lot numbers not moved to the selected side will have their quantities set to zero." + Chr(13) + Chr(13) End If
If MsgBox(lotTrackedMsg + "Once this record is posted, you will be unable to modify it and the quantities will be updated in inventory. Do you wish to continue?",vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Exit function End If
Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand, enableWarningWhenNegative allowNegativeQtyOnHand = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand")) enableWarningWhenNegative = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative")) Dim bSourceBinInactive bSourceBinInactive = CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, arg.BindingSource.Transaction))
' Quantity on Hand Adjustment If CInt(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then If arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqCountedQuantity").Value < 0 Then If bSourceBinInactive = True Then cMessage = "This Qty Adjustment CAN NOT be posted because it uses an INACTIVE bin where the Counted Qty is negative." Call Forms.MessageBox(cMessage, vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "Quantity Adjustment") Exit Function End If If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = False Then ' validation is performed in DDCode event handling Exit Function End If If enableWarningWhenNegative Then cMessage = "This transaction WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand. Are you sure?" If Forms.MessageBox(cMessage, vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Quantity Adjustment") = vbNo Then Exit Function End If End If End If End If
' Bin Transfer If CInt(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 2 Then Dim cDesWarehouse, cDestBin Dim bDestBinInactive cDesWarehouse = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqDestinationWarehouseID").Value) cDestBin = Trim(arg.BindingSource.Fields("inqDestinationPartBinID").Value) bDestBinInactive = CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cRevisionID, cDesWarehouse, cDestBin, arg.BindingSource.Transaction)) If bDestBinInactive = True Then ' Bin Transfer | Inactive Bins Not Allowed at Post (Inbound) <-- Dest Bin cMessage = "This transaction CAN NOT be posted because an INACTIVE bin exists for the Destination Bin Location for the part indicated." + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + "Part: '" + cPartID + "', Revision: '" + cRevisionID + "', Warehouse: '" + cDesWarehouse + "', Bin: '" + cDestBin + "' is inactive." Call Forms.MessageBox(cMessage, vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "Post Bin Transfer") Exit Function End If cMessage = App.Ax("QuantityAdjustment").PostQuantityAdjustmentCheck(arg.Bindingsource) If cMessage <> "" Then If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = False Then cMessage = "This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for the part indicated." + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + cMessage Call MsgBox(cMessage, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Bin Transfer") Exit Function End If ' Bin Transfer | NQOH Not Allowed for inactive bin at Post (Outbound) <-- source Bin ' we send only one part to PostQuantityAdjustmentCheck, if it ends with NQOH, and the desBin is inactive, even if NegStock is allowed, the post process stops right here If bSourceBinInactive = True Then cMessage = "This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin for the Source Bin Location for the part indicated." + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + cMessage Call MsgBox(cMessage, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Bin Transfer") Exit Function End If If lotTrackedMsg <> "" Or CBool(App.Ax("SerialNumbers").IsSerialTracked(cPartID)) Then cMessage = "This transaction CAN NOT be posted because Negative Final Count is not allowed for Serial/Lot tracked parts." + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + cMessage Call MsgBox(cMessage, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Bin Transfer") Exit Function End If If enableWarningWhenNegative Then cMessage = "This transaction WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for the part indicated. Are you sure?" + vbCrLf + vbCrLf + cMessage If Forms.MessageBox(cMessage, vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Bin Transfer") = vbNo Then Exit Function End If End If End If End If
If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then If CBool(App.Ax("QuantityAdjustment").QuantityAdjustmentPeriodCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = False Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be posted, as the fiscal period for this transaction date has been closed. Either the transaction date will need to be changed or the fiscal period will need to be opened.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If End If Call App.Ax("QuantityAdjustment").PostQuantityAdjustment(arg.Bindingsource) Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3)
End Function

If CBool(App.SecurityInfo.IsCustomModulePurchased(13)) then returnMsg = Trim(App.Ax("Receipt").CheckReceiptForZeroDollarTotals(arg.Bindingsource)) If Trim(returnMsg) <> "" Then If MsgBox(returnMsg,vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Exit function End If End If End If
If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals"))=True Then If CBool(App.Ax("Receipt").ReceiptPostCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = True Then If CBool(App.Ax("Receipt").ReceiptPeriodCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = True Then postData(arg) Else Call MsgBox("This receipt cannot be posted, as the fiscal period for this transaction date has been closed. Either the transaction date will need to be changed or the fiscal period will need to be opened.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If Else If CBool(App.Ax("Receipt").GetMessageForInactivePartBins(arg.Bindingsource,msg)) = False Then Call MsgBox(msg, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If msg = App.Ax("Receipt").VerifyQuantityForInactiveBins(arg.Bindingsource, arg.Bindingsource.Fields("rmpReceiptID")) If msg<>"" Then Call MsgBox("This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin for the part(s) indicated." + vbCrlf + vbCrlf + msg, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If If CBool(arg.BindingSource.Fields("rmpLandedCost").Value) = True Then Call MsgBox("This receipt cannot be posted as it has not been linked to a landed cost.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Else Call MsgBox("This receipt cannot be posted. Either the job has been closed, the received parts have been issued or there is insufficient remaining quantity.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") End If Exit Function End If Else If CBool(App.Ax("Receipt").ReceiptPostCheck(arg.Bindingsource)) = True Then postData(arg) Else If CBool(App.Ax("Receipt").GetMessageForInactivePartBins(arg.Bindingsource,msg)) = False Then Call MsgBox(msg, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End If If CBool(arg.BindingSource.Fields("rmpLandedCost").Value) = True Then Call MsgBox("This receipt cannot be posted as it has not been linked to a landed cost.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Else Dim serialOrLotPart, negativeStockEnabled, warningMessage, negativeParts serialOrLotPart=App.Ax("Receipt").ExistsNegativeSerialLot(arg.Bindingsource) negativeStockEnabled=App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") warningMessage=App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative") negativeParts=App.Ax("Receipt").GetMessageForNegativeParts(arg.Bindingsource) If negativeStockEnabled Then msg = App.Ax("Receipt").VerifyQuantityForInactiveBins(arg.Bindingsource, arg.Bindingsource.Fields("rmpReceiptID")) If msg<>"" Then Call MsgBox("This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin for the part(s) indicated." + vbCrlf + vbCrlf + msg, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Exit Function End if If serialOrLotPart Then Call MsgBox("This transaction CAN NOT be posted because it will result in a negative quantity on hand for the serial/lot tracked part(s) indicated."&negativeParts, vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") Else If warningMessage Then If MsgBox("This transaction WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for the part(s) indicated. Are you sure?"&negativeParts, vbExclamation + vbYesNo, "Confirm") = vbYes Then postData(arg) End If Else postData(arg) End If End If Else Call MsgBox("This receipt cannot be posted. Either the job has been closed, the received parts have been issued or there is insufficient remaining quantity.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") End If End If Exit Function End If End If End If End If End Function Function postData(arg) Call App.Ax("Receipt").PostReceipt(arg.Bindingsource) Call arg.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("Parts") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PurchaseOrderLines") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobMaterials") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobOperations") Call arg.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("SalesOrderLines") End Function

Function ProcessCommand(arg) Dim statusProcess Dim sessionId

End Function
